tournament: Arnold Palmer Invitational presented by Mastercard
executive_summary: Scottie Scheffler presents exceptional value at +474 with a massive 17.3% model edge, leading the field in both SG Total (+2.89) and SG Approach (+1.08) while coming off a win in 2024. The ball-striking advantage continues with Si Woo Kim (+3471) and Collin Morikawa (+3309) offering strong mid-tier value, ranking #2 and #3 respectively in SG Approach with positive course fit adjustments. Among longshots, Harris English (+5090) stands out with a 21.5% top-10 probability despite 50/1 odds, while course history specialist Keegan Bradley (+8086) brings a +0.142 strokes course adjustment to the table.

insights.title: Scheffler Massive Model Edge
insights.insight: Scheffler shows a staggering 17.3% model edge with 17.4% win probability versus +474 odds, leading the field in SG Total (+2.89) and SG Approach (+1.08). His 2024 API win and T4 finish in 2023 demonstrate proven course performance.

insights.title: Ball-Striking Trio Undervalued
insights.insight: Si Woo Kim (+3471) and Collin Morikawa (+3309) rank #2 and #3 in SG Approach at +0.95 and +0.93 respectively, both with strong +0.064 and +0.070 course fit adjustments. Morikawa's runner-up finish in 2025 adds recent course confidence.

insights.title: English Longshot Value Play
insights.insight: Harris English at +5090 offers exceptional longshot value with a 21.5% top-10 probability and solid +1.31 SG Total. At roughly 50/1 odds, he's significantly underpriced for his statistical profile.

insights.title: Course History Specialists
insights.insight: Keegan Bradley brings the field's best course history adjustment at +0.142 strokes with +8086 odds, while Matt Fitzpatrick's +0.117 adjustment supports his +2600 price. Both have proven API track records.

insights.title: Henley Hot Recent Form
insights.insight: Russell Henley won in 2025 and finished T4 in 2024 at API, carrying momentum with +1.32 SG Total and positive +0.024 course fit. His +4855 odds don't fully reflect his recent course dominance.

insights.title: McIlroy Decent Value Despite Struggles
insights.insight: Despite recent inconsistency (T21, T15 finishes), McIlroy's +1159 odds present 7.9% model edge with his #2 SG Total (+2.04) and strong T2 finish in 2023 showing course capability.

insights.title: Matsuyama Longshot with Upside
insights.insight: Hideki Matsuyama at +5140 combines solid +1.37 SG Total with 21.1% top-10 probability, offering legitimate longshot appeal despite longer odds. His overall game remains sharp.

insights.title: Lee Recent Form Concern
insights.insight: Min Woo Lee missed the cut in 2025 API and shows minimal course fit (+0.007), making his +4628 odds questionable despite ranking #8 in SG Total. Recent course struggles are concerning.
